fixture_meta.phase_b: PaymentIntentService may return CONFIRMED or PENDING_REVIEW; pending review must persist as AWAITING_REVIEW and suppress ORDER_CREATED. phase_a_orientation.summary: OrderService.createOrder runs transactionally: reserves inventory first, creates and saves a CONFIRMED payment intent, marks the order READY, saves the order, then unconditionally publishes ORDER_CREATED with the order ID because FulfillmentPolicy always returns true. It returns the saved order; failures before completion prevent the later steps.
